[SWS_CRYPT_02416]
{DRAFT}
Signing
⌈
The interface
ara::crypto::cryp::
SignerPrivateCtx::Sign
shall implement the signing algorithm configured for this
context. The interface shall return
•
kUninitializedContext
, if
ara::crypto::cryp::SignerPrivate-
Ctx::SetKey
was not called before.
•
kInvalidInputSize
, if a supplied
ara::crypto::ReadOnlyMemRegion
parameter's size is incompatible with the configured signature algorithm.
⌋
